title: Hiring of Vehicles for Official Purpose at Cochin Directorate during the period September 2023 to March 2024
summary: Notice inviting two-cover sealed quotations from travel agencies/tour operators to supply various classes of hired vehicles on km/hour/day basis for official use by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin, September 2023 to March 2024.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthara P.O., Cochin - 682 020

scope.item: AC vehicle: Toyota Innova Crysta (rates up to 80 km/8 hrs, additional km, additional hours, driver allowance after 8 hrs)
AC vehicle: Mahindra Xylo / Marazzo / Maruti Suzuki Ertiga / XL6 (7 or 8 seater MUV)
AC vehicle: Maruti Suzuki Swift Dezire / Toyota Etios / Honda Amaze (5 seater sedan)
AC vehicle: Maruti Suzuki Swift / Tata Tiago / Tata Punch (5-seater hatchback)

money.performance_security: Rs 10,000 as FDR from a nationalised bank or bank guarantee, valid 3 months beyond contract tenure
money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR (original) from any commercial/nationalised bank in favour of Director, Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin, valid three months; firms seeking exemption must submit valid NSIC/MSME certificate. Rates inclusive of POL, fuel, taxes, maintenance, driver allowance; GST paid on billing; no escalation. Payment per trip/monthly against duty slips.

period.completion: September 2023 to March 2024 (extendable at same rates)

eligibility: Company registration in Kerala and a local office in Kochi (proof by BSNL bill, registration certificate or Govt document; rental agreement not accepted)
At least three years' experience providing hired vehicles to Government/Semi-Govt/PSUs
At least 10 vehicles of its own (RC/ownership/lease documents)
Not blacklisted; unconditional bid; acceptance of terms (Annexure III affidavits)
Last 3 years income tax returns and proof of financial stability
Vehicles not more than five years old; drivers with valid licence and 5 years' experience
specs: AC vehicles: Innova Crysta; Xylo/Marazzo/Ertiga/XL6; Swift Dezire/Etios/Amaze; Swift/Tiago/Punch; Tempo Traveller 17- and 24-seater
Vehicles to be commercially registered, not older than five years, with 'ON GOVT OF INDIA DUTY' sticker
